'''Copero Villa''' was a residence of the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Copero/Legends|Copero]].<ref name="GalacticSeasons6" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Copero Villa is a Copero stronghold first introduced in the [[March]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.4.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can unlock Copero Villa as a stronghold in the Galactic Seasons 6 "Building a Foundation" event.<ref name="GalacticSeasons6" />
